# dsh-plugin-wenkai-font
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that switches the Web GUI's interface and conversation text to **LXGW WenK
ai (霞鹜文楷)**. The web font is bundled, so it works offline: an installed copy of the typeface is used
first (no download), and the packaged woff2 subsets are fetched only when the font is missing.
把 DeepSeek Harness 的界面 / 对话文字字体切换为 **霞鹜文楷（LXGW WenKai）** 的 Harness 插件。字体文件随插件内置，离线可用：系统已安装霞鹜文楷时直接使用本
机字体（零下载），未安装时按需加载内置的 woff2 分片。

Plugin Manager 的 `install_bundle` 直接安装本目录。启用后重新加载一次页面：Host 半会把样式表注入 index 文档，Client 半则负责给已经打开的页面补挂。
## Scope / 生效范围
- **Interface and conversation text**: the plugin puts LXGW WenKai ahead of the built-in text stack
through the Harness theme variable `--dsh-font-family-text`, so `body` and every component that read

s `--dsw-font-family` follow (Markdown, composer, sidebar, settings, and so on).
- **Code blocks and
terminal are intentionally left alone**: they follow `--ds-font-family-code` and the sidebar termin
al's xterm font setting. Set them separately in **Settings → General → More font settings** (for exa
mple `LXGW WenKai Mono`, which requires the Mono variant to be installed). Choosing a text font in S
ettings writes the same variable inline on `body`, so a user's explicit choice overrides this plugin
tes the same variable inline on `body`, so a user's explicit choice overrides this plugin's default.
- **界面与对话文本**：通过 Harness 主题变量 `--dsh-font-family-text` 把「霞鹜文楷」放在内置字体栈之前，`body`（外壳样式）和所有读取 `--dsw-fon

t-family` 的组件（Markdown、输入框、侧栏、设置页等）都会跟随。
- **代码块 / 终端**：有意不改，分别由 `--ds-font-family-code` 与侧栏终端的 xter
m 字体设置控制，可在 **设置 → 通用 → 更多字体设置** 中单独指定（例如终端用 `LXGW WenKai Mono`，需系统已安装等宽版）。在设置里为「文本」另行选择字体时，设置值以内联变量
写到 `body`，会覆盖本插件的默认值——插件不会强制覆盖用户选择。
## How it works / 实现方式
| Part | File | Role |
| Host half | index.js | Registers the prefix route `/dsh-wenkai`, serves `font.css` and the package
d woff2 subsets, and listens to `webserver/index-inject` to put the stylesheet `<link>` into the ind

ex document `<head>` before the app paints. |
| Client half | client.js | Attaches the same styleshe
et to a page that was already open (skipped when the Host half already injected it) and removes the

`<link>` on unload. |
| Stylesheet | `assets/font.css` | 97 `@font-face` rules: `src` first tries `l
ocal("LXGW WenKai")` / `local("LXGWWenKai-Regular")` / `local("霞鹜文楷")`, then the packaged subset; en

ds with `:root{--dsh-font-family-text:"LXGW WenKai","霞鹜文楷"}`. |
| Font assets | `assets/fonts/*.woff
2` | LXGW WenKai Regular (400) split into woff2 subsets by `unicode-range`, copied byte-for-byte fro

m `lxgw-wenkai-webfont@1.7.0` (upstream v1.250); the OFL text ships alongside. |
| Bundle manifest |
package.json / cordis.patch.yml | `dsh.bundle.patch` inserts the `wenkai-font` row; `dsh.client` de

clares the browser half. |
| Display metadata | locale/ / icon.png | Title, description, and icon sh
own by Plugin Manager. |

式表 `<link>` 注入 index 文档 `<head>`，首屏即可用新字体 |

lar（400）按 unicode-range 切分的 woff2 分片，逐字节复制；OFL 文本随附 |

## Settings / 启停
- Toggle the "霞鹜文楷字体" row on the Plugins page (or through `plugin_manager` / the profile patch layer

).
- The route prefix is `/dsh-wenkai/...`; packaged subsets are fetched only for the `unicode-range
` chunks the page actually uses.

- 在 Plugins 页面里启停「霞鹜文楷字体」一行，或通过 `plugin_manager` / profile 补丁层操作。
- 路由路径固定为 `/dsh-wenkai/...`；内置分片只为
页面实际用到的 unicode 区段按需拉取。
## Verify / 验证
1. After the page loads, `document.fonts.check('16px "LXGW WenKai"')` should be `true`, and `getComp

utedStyle(document.body).fontFamily` should mention `LXGW WenKai`.
2. `curl -I http://127.0.0.1:<por

t>/dsh-wenkai/font.css` and any subset should return `200` with the right `content-type`.
3. Plugin
Manager's detail view should show the title and description and render this package's icon.
## License / 许可
Plugin code and artwork are MIT (LICENSE). The bundled font is SIL Open Font License 1.1; copyright,
source, modifications, and redistribution requirements are in FONT-LICENSES.md, and the complete OF
L text ships as `assets/fonts/OFL.txt`.

体文件一起位于 `assets/fonts/OFL.txt`。
